overview: UdyamAI is a mobile-first hyper-local market analysis and financial planning app for rural Indian entrepreneurs, turning available capital and business requirements into a transparent, deterministic financial plan with government scheme guidance.
features: Deterministic financial planning engine (project cost, loan, EMI, interest, repayment, working capital, break-even)
Government scheme database with deterministic scheme routing
Financial UI with repayment schedule, principal-vs-interest chart, and plain-language explanations
Interactive What-if Lab with real-time scenario sliders
Transparent feasibility score and final recommendation
